policies.name: internal-messages-are-free
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"send_message", resource) when { context.recipient_internal == true };

policies.name: allowlisted-external-needs-human
policies.code:
@enforcement_effect("require_approval")
permit(principal, action == Action::"send_message", resource) when { context.recipient_internal == false && ["partner.example", "vendor.example"].contains(context.recipient_domain) };

tests.name: allowlisted external holds for a human
